chunks: But you went back (on your word), and but for the mercy and grace of God you were lost.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's mercy preventing loss despite human failure?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition from the merit of the covenant to the necessity of divine grace, illustrating that human obedience is fragile and dependent on Allah's mercy. It serves as a reminder that without the sustaining favor of God, even those who initially accepted the truth would have fallen into loss, underscoring the concept of 'fadl' (grace) as the ultimate determinant of success.
